toegepas.blok: Plante wat ver van mekaar staan
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two coordinate adjectives describing the same noun are separated by a comma.
toegepas.fout: Two coordinate adjectives ('dik' and 'vlesige', both describing the stems and leaves) stand without the separating comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS comma between coordinate adjectives is a plain punctuation fix and leaves the meaning exactly as it was.

toegepas.blok: Plante wat ver van mekaar staan
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Uitloop' suggests sprouting or running out; 'versprei' says plainly that the roots spread wide and shallow.
toegepas.fout: 'loop wyd en vlak uit' is a loose verb for roots; 'uitloop' leans towards sprouting or running out.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'versprei wyd en vlak' is the exact, natural verb for roots spreading, keeps the same meaning, and leaves the rest of the sentence (including 'om vinnig reën op te vang', a wording dropped from change in an earlier round) untouched.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die kaarte van hierdie streek wys
laat_vaar.voor: is die woestyn dus die teenoorgestelde
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Two consecutive sentences both lean on 'dus'; the second is protected, so dropping the first removes the repetition without changing the claim.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The first 'dus' carries the inference from the previous sentence (the lightest shades, like the poles) and is contrasted by 'egter' in the next, so dropping it loses a logical link for little gain.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Same coordinate-adjective comma as in the study text, so the block and the glossary read alike; the reviewer may route this to the writer because it is a definition.
na_skrywer.fout: The glossary definition has the same missing comma between coordinate adjectives, and once change 1 is applied it will differ in punctuation from the study text.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition that may be shared word for word across lessons, so the writer should make the comma change for every lesson at once rather than a language agent changing one copy.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die maandelikse gemiddeldes wys min of geen reën van maand tot maand.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die gemiddeldes vir elke maand wys min of geen reën.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Maandelikse' and 'van maand tot maand' say the same thing twice.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: It removes 'maandelikse gemiddeldes', the curriculum's own term used across the sub-topic, and 'van maand tot maand' adds 'every month through the year' rather than merely repeating it.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Plante wat ver van mekaar staan
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: om vinnig reën op te vang
laat_vaar_vorige.na: om reën vinnig op te vang
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans the object naturally goes before the manner adverb here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: With an indefinite object both orders are natural Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: in plaas van 'n blaredak te vorm
laat_vaar_vorige.na: in plaas daarvan om 'n blaredak te vorm
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Standard Afrikaans uses 'in plaas daarvan om ... te' before an infinitive clause.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'in plaas van ... te vorm' is accepted standard Afrikaans; the proposal is only longer and heavier for a Grade 6 reader.
